note: Penryn was first released in 2007 on a 45nm process, succeeding Conroe in Intel's Core 2 series.
'Native Support' indicates GPU is natively supported without patches. 'Patch Support' indicates hardware requires OCLP root patches.
CPUs with SSE4.1 can be patched up to macOS Tahoe 26; otherwise limited to macOS 10.11.6.
SSE4.1 is required for macOS 10.12 Sierra and newer; processors lacking SSE4.1 (e.g. Conroe) cannot boot newer macOS versions.
Apple removed USB 1.1 controller drivers in macOS Ventura 13+. Use a PCIe-to-USB 3.0 card during installation, then apply OCLP USB 1.1 root patches.
Most LGA775 motherboards lack UEFI support and require OpenCore Duet/emulated UEFI.
